bagPolicy.summary: No bags are allowed except small clutches up to 4" x 6", medical bags and diaper bags.
prohibited: All other bags, including backpacks and purses
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are searched at entry. Check the event page for any extra requirements from the artist or presenter.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Maverik Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Maverik Center. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Maverik Center offers a variety of food and drink options including burgers, fries, nachos, and ice cream. Highlights include the Bacon Cheeseburger, Chicken Tinga Tacos, and a selection of flavored milkshakes. Special offerings feature a range of desserts and premium items.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is at the top of Sections 117, 118, 119, 121, 122, and 123, with more on a show-by-show basis. Ask for it when buying in person or by phone, or use the Accessibility icon in the Ticket Filters on ticketmaster.com. Accessible parking is in Lots A, B, and C, first come, first served, with a placard or plate displayed.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited. Medical and emergency exceptions may be allowed. Contact staff or a supervisor before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Maverik Center Box Office opens at 2:00 PM on event days.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Maverik Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
